description_en: Resets the password of a database account for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb reset-account-password --db-instance-id gp-t4nf48vf157130000 --account-name testaccount_1 --account-password Testaccount_1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetAccountPassword

parameters.help_en:
Before you call this operation, make sure that the following requirements are met:

The instance is in the running state.
The instance is not locked
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号密码。
由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成。
特殊符号包含：`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
密码长度为8~32个字符
parameters.name: account_password

RequestId.description_en: The new password for the account. The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length and contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. Special characters include `! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =`
